controls.trust_read: Exact viewer, active profile and target binding with bounded assessment shapes.
controls.appeal_lifecycle: One open appeal per content commitment, confidential reason and replay-stable outcome.
controls.notifications: Owner/profile/read-state and preference mutations accept only exact authoritative results.
controls.gdpr_lifecycle: Account/session bound export and deletion journeys; UUID export identifiers are preserved.
controls.profile_settings: Active-profile-only edits with frozen intent and exact username/profile results.
controls.live_drafts: Owner/profile/action bound local preview and competition drafts with server-side privacy declaration.
controls.creator_studio: Publish intent is frozen and result-bound to owner, profile, content commitment and audio-rights lineage.
controls.local_drafts: IndexedDB v2 owner/profile partition, 20-draft quota, 20 MB media bounds and corruption denial.
controls.camera_lifecycle: Latest-request camera acquisition, stale stream teardown, abandoned recorder denial and recorder-specific timeout.

findings_resolved.problem: Late camera permission results and recorder callbacks could survive navigation or profile changes.
findings_resolved.resolution: Generation gates, DOM/profile checks, discard-marked recorders and exact-stream teardown now fail closed.

findings_resolved.problem: Profile, notification, lifecycle and publishing clients could trust structurally successful but context-mismatched mutation results.
findings_resolved.resolution: Every covered mutation now validates the authoritative owner, profile, target, action and committed state before local success.

findings_resolved.problem: Device-local creator drafts lacked a strict per-profile quota and corruption boundary.
findings_resolved.resolution: Drafts are partitioned by owner/profile, bounded, allow-listed and rejected on invalid identity, metadata or media.
